verdict.rationale: Slate is a terminal coding agent, so cross-device task continuation is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows switching between existing sessions within the TUI (`/sessions`) and running long sessions. Nothing documents syncing a session to another device or resuming it from a browser, and local session switching is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start a task on one device and continue it later from another device or browser
